notes.title: Update v0.4.19 – ☢ The Rad Rework & Save System Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/c88ee7b1f0065a57dbebbeb53f117d975f5cd375.png[/img]

Survivors, a major update is here! This release refines and expands upon the v0.4.18 Beta Branch, bringing a rad system rework, upgraded save mechanics, an all-new ambient sound manager, gamemode presets, achievements, and much more! Thank you to those who helped us test out the beta branch! Let’s break it down.

[h2]Key Features & Changes[/h2]

[h3]☢ Rad Rework[/h3]

The radiation system has been revamped! Expect better balancing, new rad-tier mechanics, and a host of new rad-related items to help you survive.

The old radiation system was just percentage-based, where having certain clothing items or accessories equipped would lead to a lower percentage of radiation poisoning. [b]The new system is now tier-based[/b], meaning that different zones will require a greater tier of radiation protection. If you get 100 protection, you have now reached LEGENDARY status and are [b]immune to radiation poisoning[/b]. There are a few different routes to achieve 100 rad protection, a little tip… take advantage of your accessory slots!

[list]
[*] New Rad Med Container – Find the new anti-rad meds more in high rad areas.
[*] Spirulina Algae (grows in toxic water areas) – Can now be crafted into:
- Spirulina Algae Cig
- Spirulina Algae Tea
- Spirulina Algae Pills
[/list]

[h3]💾 Save System Upgrades[/h3]

We’re overhauling saves to ensure better stability and functionality:

[list]
[*] Save history tracking (e.g., ABC, ABC_1, ABC_2) – Never lose track of past saves.
[*] Backup saves now listed separately in the Load Menu.
[*] Fixed world container saves – No more lost items due to missing data.
[*] Vehicle saves now preserved when using the save fixer.
[*] UI tweaks for Load Menu integration into Pause & Main Menus.
[/list]

[h3]🎶 Ambient Sound Manager Implemented[/h3]

[list]
[*] A new ambient sound system adds immersive environmental audio that changes based on the time of day.
[/list]

[h3]🎮 Gamemode Presets[/h3]

We’re introducing pre-configured settings for different gameplay styles.

[list]
[*] HardcoreModeSettings
[*] MoreLootSettings
[/list]

[h3]⭐ Achievements Overhaul[/h3]

Implemented 10 achievements!

[h2]🔧 General Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Major bunker loot buffs
[*] Fixed containers with incorrect interact names
[*] Fixed Tainted Guzzler issue – Now properly cleans in a campfire or furnace.
[*] Fixed MainLevel collisions
[*] Added missing ladders
[*] Fixed minimap inconsistencies (Thanks to ClusterDuck & others!)
[*] Increased loot across all sources (containers, AI, road warriors, etc.).
[*] RadRX now has 8 uses, visually represented by its pill mesh.
[*] More stones can now be picked up in the environment.
[*] Mouse input in vehicles now respects sensitivity & inverted settings.
[*] Fixed admin teleport bug – You can now teleport across the map (allegedly).
[*] Improved reload animations for shotguns when swapping items.
[*] Quickbind Timer adjustment – Prevents multiple hotkey spamming.
[*] New tooltips added for key items (e.g., keycards now indicate usage locations).
[*] Further developments on the Cave POI
[*] Added keycards to admin spawn list
[/list]

This update was majorly driven by the community's feedback. Thank you all so much for taking the time to help take the game to the next level! Stay tuned, we have another exciting update coming at the beginning of April!!!

notes.title: Beta Branch Update v0.4.18 – Survivors Needed!
notes.content:
We're rolling out changes to the core save system, and we need survivors to help stress-test it on the Beta Branch (Enlist Below 🫡). This update also includes a rad system revamp, loot improvements, bug fixes, and quality-of-life enhancements. More to come in the official public update, but let’s break it down:

[h2]Key Changes & Fixes[/h2]
[h3]🎮 Gameplay & Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Loot increased across all sources (containers, AI, road warriors, etc.).
[*] Rad System revamped – now uses tiers instead of modifiers for better balancing.
[*] Minimap fixes for more consistent interaction (thanks to ClusterDuck & others!).
[*] RadRX now has 8 uses, visually represented by its pill mesh.
[*] More stones can now be picked up across MainLevel.
[/list]
[h3]🛠 Save System Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Save history tracking added (e.g., ABC, ABC_1, ABC_2).
[*] Backup saves now listed separately in the Load Menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where world containers weren’t saving properly, leading to lost items.
[*] Vehicle saves are now preserved when using the save fixer.
[*] Adjusted UI elements (Pause & Main Menus) to integrate with the new Load Menu system.
[/list]
[h3]🚗 Vehicles & UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mouse input in vehicles now respects sensitivity & inverted settings.
[*] Fixed admin teleport bug – (fixed an issue when trying to interact with players outside of the players net relevance bubble). Fully fixed in v0.4.19.
[/list]
[h3]🔧 General Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various collision issues and LOD adjustments.
[*] Further developments on Cave POI.
[*] Fixed reload animation glitch on shotguns when swapping items.
[*] Improved Quickbind Timer – prevents spamming multiple hotkeys at once.
[*] Added new tooltips for key items (e.g., keycards now indicate where to use them).
[*] Added new nature ambient tech – still being fine-tuned before the next update.
[*] Setup 3D text fonts for Russian, Chinese, Japanese. Text in tutorial should now localize better to these languages.
[*] Fixed two bugs that would separately result in the player holding a glitched gun.
[*] Fixed issue that would cause certain weapons looted from world containers to not load ammo properly.

[/list]

[h2]⚠ Beta Testers Needed![/h2]
This update is LIVE on our Beta Branch. We need you to push the new save system to its limits and report any issues. 

https://discord.gg/vk8kz2CDEE ← Enlist in the Beta Branch!

Your feedback is invaluable in ensuring a smooth rollout for everyone.

Thanks for being part of the community, survivors! 🧟‍♂️🔦💾

notes.content:

[h2]Hotfix Update: Don't PANIC. IM NOT PANICING!+#%(&[/h2]

No worries, survivors. There was just a small misstep made when we made the last build. It allowed everyone to be an admin without our authorization check... OOPS (Dev Ears fault): We often disable this check when doing testing in the editor and forgot to re-enable it. Not to worry, we turned it back on.

In better news, we [b]added new types of tooltips to "important" items[/b]. The keycard is the perfect example of an important item. You'll notice they have a tip on where to use them!  This was recommended by a few survivors and pointed out by Oreon:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/bb41c2ed10a0f282edd12ccc76ac24a16ddc8a1b.png[/img]

We have made it [b]much easier now[/b]! Thank you for the positive feedback, we have been listening with our dev "ear"s. Please keep it coming, as it helps our team significantly and shapes ZSGO.

We also [b]added some new nature ambient tech[/b] that needs some tweaking. We are looking to tidy this up before the release of our next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/31f4e480c89007f1fffd8b77e7b20cf79fd1cf43.png[/img]

Lastly, there were some [b]collision fixes across MainLevel[/b] as usual!

Bummed you didn't get to try the admin menu? Well, you're in luck! You can follow our [url=https://zsgo.fandom.com/wiki/Guide_to_Setting_Up_Admin_Menu_in_ZSGO
] detailed steps here [/url] to set the admin menu up on your server!

Good luck out there survivors and prepare yourselves for the upcoming update, v0.4.18, which will come out in February!

P.S. You may be seeing some more keycards lyin around. (shhhhh)

notes.title: v0.4.15 Winter Update [+] Year In Review
notes.content:
As we celebrate a full year since the official launch of ZSGO, we’re excited to bring you the v0.4.15 Winter Update, packed with festive cheer, snow, ice, fixes, and for what’s to come in 2025. Thank you all so much for your support, survivors <3 Where does the time go?

[h2]Winter-Themed Additions[/h2]
[b]The Snow IS BACK![/b]  
Winter is here, and while the snow has always been part of our seasonal weather schedule, it’s here to stay for the colder months! Survival just got a little chillier. Don't worry, the regular weather schedule is still in effect.

[b]Santa Claws Returns![/b]  
Santa’s back with a sack full of juicy presents! Head over to his location and get your hands on his secret loot. (Santa might have some key cards for you if you were good this year ;)

[b]More Presents, More Loot![/b]  
We’ve scattered presents and festive loot all around the world for you to find. Happy holidays, survivors!

[h2]Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements[/h2]
[b]Optimized Lighting on Main Level[/b]  
We've reduced shader complexity on MainLevel, meaning you should see a boost in frame rates and smoother gameplay overall (esp when in the sewer!).

[b]Main Menu Winter Redesign[/b]  
The Main Menu has gotten a festive makeover and a fresh look!

[b]Good Trader Vehicle Fix[/b]  
Vehicle’s in the good trader POI were having some trouble navigating in and out of the entrance/swamp area, but it’s been fixed. Thank you for the reports.

[b]Removed Floating World Items[/b]  
We’ve cleaned up some issues with floating world items that were disrupting the world’s realism.

[h2]Map and Gameplay Fixes[/h2]
[b]Sewer Cue Location Fix[/b]  
The sewer cue box was slightly sticking outside of the POI, causing players on the beach or outside of the sewer to hear some sound effects intended only to be heard inside the sewer POI.

[b]Fixed Spawn Inside Rock Mesh[/b]  
Players reported spawning inside a rock mesh on the beach - this issue has been resolved.

[b]Fixed Main Menu Cue Loop[/b]  
The Main Menu cue loop stopped looping, but should be working now (allegedly fixed).

[b]Added Teleport Locations[/b]  
New teleportation locations have been added to improve navigation and make your travels a bit easier when using the admin menu. [url=https://zsgo.fandom.com/wiki/Guide_to_Setting_Up_Admin_Menu_in_ZSGO]> Admin Menu ZSGO <[/url]

[h2]Nav Mesh and Level Updates[/h2]
[b]Nav Mesh Regeneration for All Levels[/b]  
All levels, including demo and tutorial, were using old optimizations. We’ve regenerated the nav meshes for a smoother experience and more responsive gameplay from all AI.

[b]Randomized Door State Fixed on Tutorial[/b]  
The randomized door state on the tutorial and other important POIs has been corrected to prevent any unwanted surprises. Sorry for those who encountered any freebie doors / locked ones - and thank you for reporting!

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
[b]Exciting Updates in the Works[/b]  
Our team has been hard at work behind the scenes, ready for 2025. We can’t wait for another amazing year with you all as we continue to enhance and expand ZSGO. Thank you for putting your trust in our small team & dreams.

[h2]Year in Review[/h2]
As we celebrate ZSGO’s first year, let’s take a moment to look back on the incredible progress we’ve made together. Here’s a detailed list of all major updates from the past year:

[table equalcells=1]

notes.title: 🎃 Halloween Update v0.4.13 🔴 NEW Mutant, Skeletons, and Meat Piles???
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/16ecdcce10636803990f99ed803f4ed8824bc57b.png[/img]

Hello, survivors! 

We’re excited to roll out the [b]Halloween Update v0.4.13[/b], packed with spooky new content and important fixes. This update introduces tons of new features for both the Main game and the Demo, along with performance improvements and bug fixes.

Below is a breakdown of everything included in this update:

[h2]🧟 Content Additions:[/h2]

Meat Piles (Zombie spawners that need to be destroyed) have been added to both DemoLand and MainLevel. These will now be a key part of your survival challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/a26c72a4a64e3dc552dbdc316ca6b114fc309ffa.gif[/img]

New Blind Mutant AI: This new enemy only reacts to sound and hits much harder than zombies. Watch your step and be super quiet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/079a68c4da43ef9ff6304d174f2dd352c7a0f3fb.png[/img]

New Skeleton Zombies: Skeleton zeds have been added to the rad zed, armored zed, and random zombie pools.

Pumpkin Pie and Pumpkin Pie Slices: Seasonal food items have been added. Yum! A Fall classic, that warms your heart when you’re starving in the apocalypse.

New Foliage: 3 new types have been added to celebrate the season—Carved Pumpkin Patches, Single Door Cobwebs, and Double Door Cobwebs. Expect pumpkins and cobwebs across the map, with certain areas keeping them permanently (caves, farms, etc.).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/796d4830698fe667452a6958c0d55984bbe47e6a.png[/img]

Round 1 Localizations: Mandarin, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, French & Arabic.

Demo Update: DemoLand has received a fresh update, that brings many new features that the main game provides. They too, get to experience the Halloween vibe as we celebrate Scream Fest.

Demo Vehicle Trader: A new vehicle trader has been added to DemoLand, offering a variety of vehicles.
Full Backtrack to Demo: Added our full backtrack to the demo.

New Map Player Marker: Players now have a more precise marker on the map.

[h2]🔨 Bug Fixes:[/h2]

Two Pairs of Hands Bug: Added insurance to ensure there will never be two hands displayed simultaneously.

Zombie Attack Bug: Fixed an issue where zombies would stop attacking the player after chasing them.

LOD Fixes: Several meshes (truck with cargo, tree stump, etc.) with incorrect LODs rendering into triangles have been corrected.

[h2]🔧 Performance and Quality of Life Updates:[/h2]

Server Zombie Spawn Limits: Server hosts can now limit zombie spawns per player (default 10 zombies/AI per player). This should significantly improve performance for all players.

AI Spawn Cooldowns: Increased minimum and maximum time values for AI Spawn Cooldowns. After an AI spawn point is used, it will take 10-33 minutes to reactivate it. This helps reduce constant zombie spawn waves.

In-Game Save File Creation: The game now always creates a save file when launched if one with the same name doesn't already exist. This change also applies to dedicated servers and fixes some edge case log-off issues.

Video Settings Fix: The in-game video settings button is now correctly linked to the proper widget.
Floating Melee Weapon Fix: Fixed a bug where slower framerates could cause floating melee weapons when switching from a gun.

Gunfire Sound Fix: Fixed muzzle location not being set properly, affecting gunfire sound positioning for the AI.

[h2]🖥️ Visual & Animation Enhancements:[/h2]

New Animation Cues: Improved and added new animations across the board for a more polished experience.

Resource Shrink Effect: A visual effect was added when harvesting resources. You'll now see resources shrinking as you gather them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/1c32683c7de340b00aef1f38ffce0549672a73bc.gif[/img]

Tree Jostle Effect: Trees will now jostle when hit with an axe, adding more immersion to resource gathering.
Explosion Effect for Meat Piles: Added explosion effect for destroying meat piles for added impact.

This update is a huge leap forward in refining the gameplay experience and celebrating the spooky season. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. Please keep reporting any issues or bugs you encounter!

[url=https://zsgo.atlassian.net/rest/collectors/1.0/template/form/8381ca5e style=button]Report a Bug![/url]

Happy Halloween and good luck out there, survivors!

notes.title: ZSGO Dev Vlog 3 🔴 Dreams, Goals, & Undertakings
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/c345d6a0454ef64dbdef7174fa30640718ce26ad.png[/img]

As some of you may know, we have been working towards adding the features we originally proposed on the [url=https://www.playzsgo.com/open-world-zombie-game/]Future Roadmap[/url], while simultaneously working on a huge system overhaul in the background. This document will outline the current progress and mission for ZSGO, as well as the constant goal to make our game as accessible to the world as possible. It will then conclude with the outline of our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fundzsgo/zombie-survival-game-online-round-2-system-overhauls]Kickstarter rewards[/url] provided in our current campaign.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AvdPPeru24I

[h2]An Update from Dev Gibby [/h2]
Howdy Survivors! Welcome to the next chapter of ZSGO. 

I'm Dev Gibby, CEO and project manager and I am thrilled to share some of the recent news and updates surrounding the game. Our small but nimble team of developers has been hard at work building the game design document, communicating with the player base, and securing additional funding through Kickstarter and other mega grants. Ultimately building the future of ZSGO. 

It has been an incredible journey so far, and we cannot thank the community and the survivors in the wasteland enough. Thank you for being the backbone of our game. Our small indie team hopes to bring our title higher up on the charts and compete with the big dogs.

At last, let’s jump right into the exciting features we have come up with.

Our latest update brings dedicated server support to the public. This has been a long time coming. Playing on a dedicated server not only allows you to free up CPU usage but also gives you the freedom to play with your friends and customize the server to your liking. This has been an overarching goal of ours to allow more customizations and more configurable options to our player base. A big shoutout to Dev Yellow, who is new to our team and helped us overcome some of these multiplayer challenges. 

We want to continue to grow our game by making it more accessible to more players and languages around the globe. That brings the introduction to our first language support added to the game, German. A big shoutout to our Mod, Evelator.  We have had several community members reach out who are bilingual or speak multiple languages and want to help translate our game. 

[h2]Current Goals for Pre-Overhaul Build[/h2]
The current goal for our pre-overhaul build is to be able to provide survivors with the deliverables that we had promised in the past. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/2a744ce73bb9c3545eee56dfb19c455be19213d9.png[/img]

Vehicles, one of our most requested additions to the game, are extremely close to finally being released. This will allow survivors to [url=https://www.playzsgo.com/island-survival-game/]traverse across the island[/url] faster than ever before. VOIP, In-Game Events, and maybe even an electricity system are other goals that we are working towards implementing before the release of our system overhaul. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/328066d867f3495068ff7058998082c0495551bf.jpg[/img]

The main reason we chose to pursue these changes is because they are decoupled and can be ripped out and added to the system overhaul build with ease. That way, once we reach the finish line, survivors will still be able to use all the features they have always had access to!   

[h2]Things Happening Behind the Scenes[/h2]
As mentioned, behind the scenes there is another build being simultaneously worked on by Dev Jest and Dev Poggers. This is where major systems are currently being completely rebuilt to better fit what we want to be able to do with ZSGO.
[h3]Current Undertakings[/h3]
The first systems that we have started building are the inventory system and the combat system. The inventory system is what controls everything involved with the character's items and how they interact with these items. The combat system is a bit more than just combat. This will essentially change how anything that affects a player is handled. 
[h3]Other Overarching System Overhaul Goals[/h3]
Of course, we are interested in also building a hive system, a faction system, and a progression system. If you are interested in learning more about all of the changes to come, we outlined it in greater detail on our Kickstarter. If you have any questions about these system overhauls, be sure to stop by the [url=https://discord.com/invite/AzPa3zUSNc]ZSGO Discord[/url] and ask us about them. We are usually always on. :)

[h2]Always Striving Towards Accessibility[/h2]
Our main goal with ZSGO is to make the game as accessible as possible to the world. Not only by translating the game but also by allowing players to customize the game to their liking using the [url=https://zsgo.fandom.com/wiki/World_Settings_Manager]World Settings Manager[/url], the [url=https://zsgo.fandom.com/wiki/Adjusting_AI_Spawn_Manager_Settings]AI Spawn Manager[/url], and much more in the future! 

A huge part of creating a game in a way that is as accessible as possible is listening to the community and their feedback. We recently launched a [url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/YKRJGYP]Survival Game Preferences Survey[/url] that survivors can take so we have a better feel for what the community is looking for.

[h2]Kickstarter Rewards![/h2]
For those who are interested in our limited-time Kickstarter rewards, this last section is for you! Our current campaign offers 6 different rewards: 
The “Kickstarter Goat” Discord role, gives you lifetime access to the behind-the-scenes channel.
Custom HD ZSGO wallpapers.
Get your name permanently etched into the safe zone in-game.
Name the building of your choice in-game.
Name an in-game zombie.
Receive a first-edition ZSGO CD. (Only 25 are made and will ever be made)
If you are interested in any of these rewards or read more about our future plans for ZSGO, be sure to hit the button below to head on over to our Kickstarter.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fundzsgo/zombie-survival-game-online-round-2-system-overhauls style=button]Visit the ZSGO Kickstarter![/url]

Thank you to everyone who has supported us this far. We have always expressed how big our plans for ZSGO are, and are excited to finally start pursuing the massive system overhauls that will lead to our dream game!

Good luck out there survivors! :D

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/dee5b10bc6327aadff6208c6b9578d2a062339e6.png[/img]

Howdy again, survivors! 

It’s been crazy times in the background. We are excited to unveil everything we have been working on over the last month. This announcement will glance over the public dedicated server, our transition to Unreal Engine 5.3, and the “Enhancing Core Systems” topic we briefly touched on in [url=https://www.playzsgo.com/april-dev-announcement/]our last announcement[/url]. 

[h2]Dedicated Server Testing[/h2]
We have officially started testing the dedicated servers in preparation for publishing the dedicated server tool to Steam later on in the month! This will allow survivors to host servers on their machines! Beta testing for this tool will begin next week and will be public on May 27th. If you are interested in helping with testing these servers, be sure to opt-in to the beta branch in [url=https://discord.com/invite/playzsgo]the ZSGO discord[/url].

[h2]Transition to UE 5.3[/h2]
As you already know from the April Dev Announcement, we have been in the process of swapping over to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b4_msnAbJtk]Unreal Engine 5.3[/url]. This is our first time updating the engine, so there have been some major hurdles that we have successfully overcome, along with a few more we are still dealing with. We are confident that this was the move and can’t wait to start using all the new features that this version provides. 

[h2]Combat System Overhaul[/h2]
While we don’t want to go into too much detail yet, this is the first step in pursuing the future plans referenced in the title. We all know that the current melee system is a little wonky, and it’s finally time to craft something far more fun and engaging for all the survivors out there.

Later on in the month, there will be a more detailed view of what this new combat system will consist of. This will be more than just making your axe swing look cooler, we can’t wait for y’all to see! 

[h2]Funding to Grow the Game[/h2]
For those who made it this far lol - Currently, we're actively seeking another round of funding to propel project ZSGO forward. We're eager to provide survivors with comprehensive updates on the systems we're enhancing and look forward to revealing more. While we are very committed to rolling out these updates, the timeline may extend without extra funding and will just take more time. Despite [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fundzsgo/zombie-survival-game-online?ref=discovery]our first Kickstarter campaign[/url] not reaching its goal and being unsuccessful, our team managed to persevere! We are gearing up for a second campaign to continue our progress and deliver an updated roadmap. We have also been applying for other grant opportunities and will keep yall updated on any advancements.

Thank you so much for the support, survivors! These are exciting times, and big things are right around the corner. Creating this dream game is impossible without all the support you guys have given so far. <3

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194339/f69305bf2a614af9208146660babbd3b6dea911e.png[/img]

Howdy survivors! 

It’s been about 3 weeks since the March Update (v0.4.8.0), so we just thought we would update the community on what we’ve been cooking up behind the scenes! This update will touch on 3 parts: the upcoming April update, the transition to Unreal Engine 5.3, and talks of enhancements to core systems leading into the future.

[h2]The April Update[/h2]
This update (v0.4.9.0) will follow the same course as our last two, meaning a beta branch will be released before the public launch. If you are interested in joining the beta branch, head over to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/AzPa3zUSNc]ZSGO Discord[/url] and navigate to the “testing-opt-in” channel!

As for the contents of this update, without spoiling too much, we wanted to introduce a more nomadic option to survivors. This includes many alternate build parts which give the player the option to skip building a full base altogether. You will be able to board and lock up a building temporarily and move from area to area with ease (Storage tents, Placeable & upgradable doors, Window Barricades). On top of this nomad option, there will also be a variety of different zombies introduced to the world of ZSGO.

Of course, there is MUCH more coming in this patch, that’s just a bit of a sneak peek for those who are interested! ;)

[h2]Transition to Unreal Engine 5.3.2[/h2]
We have been talking about the transition for some time now, and we have officially begun migrating! We have been on version 5.0.3 since the game’s conception. Transitioning to 5.3.2 will give us access to new tools while also fixing some bugs that have been a real annoyance. 

We have been working on blueprinting the transition for a few weeks now and are excited to finally start implementing it!

[h2]Enhancing Core Systems[/h2]
While still in early discussions, we feel that some core systems in the game, such as melee combat, crafting, and zombie interaction, have much to be desired. We plan on experimenting and prototyping with some changes to these core systems behind the scenes, which will hopefully transpire to a healthy improvement to the game as a whole.

Thank you for the support survivors we can’t wait to experience [url=https://play.zsgo.co/open-world-zombie-game/]the future of ZSGO[/url] with y’all!!!

notes.title: 🩹 New Changelog v0.4.6 🏗️
notes.content:
The time has come survivors! 

Since launch, we have received FAR more feedback than we could have hoped for. Thanks to everyone’s reports and suggestions, we were able to key in on high-priority issues and get them fixed up. Weighed next to our internal list, from parsing player feedback and bug reports we felt that some of the biggest issues to address for this fix were Server Stability, Base Raiding/Ownership mechanics, and QOL bug fixes like removing the frustrating gun stutter bug. Of course, there is far more to be done and it wouldn’t be possible without y’alls support!

If you notice any bugs, be sure to [url=https://zsgo.atlassian.net/rest/collectors/1.0/template/form/8381ca5e]Report a Bug[/url]
Also, we are very active on [url=https://discord.com/invite/AzPa3zUSNc]Discord[/url], so any suggestions there are huge!

Here are the patch notes for version v0.4.6! 

[b]HIGHLIGHTS (TLDR)[/b]

– Removed permanent winter & holiday content, plans for dynamic season choices are in the works! 

– Fixed a bug that would cause the player’s hands to spasm out & stutter while holding a gun that was related to leaning.

– Only the owner can spawn on their own sleeping bag. If you try & set your spawn on someone else’s it gives you a warning.

– Weapons should now require fewer repair kits to fix, subject to further balancing.

– Fixed a couple of issues that would cause server crashes under certain conditions related to players dying, which should greatly increase server stability

[b]BUILD PART REWORK[/b]

– Adjusted raiding mechanics to allow for more specific control of raiding methods. Limited Damage to build parts greatly, now only certain tools can damage low tiers & metal tier can only be damaged by explosives.

– Increased health on all base-building parts to make for sturdier bases!

– Weapon damage is now determined not just by the weapon configuration but the ammo configuration as well, allowing more variety & customization across different weapons.  Gun damage was also essentially rebalanced here as well to a certain degree. Much more to come here.

– Adjusted explosive damage & radius to build parts.

– Fixed floating door locks.

– Adjusted the damage guns do to different base materials.

– Barbwire no longer destroys itself or other build parts.

The lamp doesn’t poof when you pick it up anymore.

[b]OWNERSHIP BOX[/b]

– Ownership Box can now overlap if placed by the same owner.

– Increased the Ownership Box ownership zone.

– Zombies should no longer spawn in the ownership radius of the Ownership Box or on any base building parts

– If you take over an Ownership Box it will no longer convert ownership on other plot poles, which would allow for players to take over full bases after claiming ownership on a single box previously.

– Beds are unaffected by Ownership Boxes for a few design reasons, the biggest one being that respawning on beds is now tied to ownership as well.

[b]ADDED CONTENT[/b]

– Added the Chem Lab crafting table.

– Introduced Metal Radio & Jimi Radio to the Main Level.

– Added a nicer path up the mountain.

– Added buildings to the in-game map.

– Added charcoal as fuel type for Taint Transformer.

– Adjusted 106.9 Judgement Day Radio to include the Discord shoutout winners & added a new song.

– Added many new items. (Including makeshift rad med, a special shower, antibiotics & more)

[b]FOR SERVER OWNERS/ DEDICATED SERVERS[/b]

– Implemented an Admin Menu Toolset with many features including:

  > Banning, Whitelist, Limit PVP, Item spawning, Teleportation, etc.

– Added a server-side kill log that records all PVP kills & their participants.

– Added more infrastructure for loading server settings dynamically from external files into game instances, more on this soon.

[b]OTHER REPORTED ISSUES[/b]

– All lootable containers are now highlighted when you try to loot them.

– Fixed all reported spots where survivors were getting stuck.

– Fixed rock collisions on several rocks that were impassible.

– Refined loot tables (reduced spawn chance %’s, added new & existing items to spawn list).

– Refined the bunkers (fixed the doors, made the entrance bigger, adjusted loot, more custom textured signs).

– The explosive crafting recipe now returns the correct item.

– Added the Chainlink trader items survivors reported.

[b]OTHER FIXES[/b]

– Significantly increased distance of explosion sounds.

– Removed the ability to shoot from within safe zones which would still damage players outside of the safe radius.

– Fixed the removal of the buzzing flies sound that would stay in the level after the removal of dead bodies.

– Fixed a major cause of clients sometimes seeing TPosed characters in place of their dead bodies, this should be gone or at least happen significantly less.

[b]FOR NEW PLAYERS[/b]

– Tutorial Tweaks, cleaned up some bug reports.

– Added a Map image to the pause menu in the demo.

– Updated various aspects of Demo Land to include some of the newer content.

[b]DEV NOTES[/b]

Your feedback is invaluable in this journey, so keep it coming! Stay tuned for more exciting developments as we inch closer to the ultimate ZSGO adventure.

Remember to report a bug, if you find one, and join Discord if you have any suggestions!

Stay alert and survive, everyone!

notes.title: 🛠️ New Changelog v0.4.4 🛠️
notes.content:
[b]Hey Survivors[/b], and a special shoutout to our newcomers! ːsteamhappyː We're still in the exciting phase of awaiting Steam's final content review. If you're eager to jump into the action early, consider backing our Patreon to [b]gain Early Access[/b] ([url=https://www.patreon.com/fundzsgo]https://www.patreon.com/fundzsgo[/url]). Meanwhile, here's a sneak peek into our development journey and the latest enhancements we've made to ZSGO:

[u][b]Major Improvements:[/b][/u]
- Fixed issue with saving build parts on dedicated servers. Now, build to your heart's desire without worries!
- Streamlined the player mission menu to fix issues with it being broken entirely after loading an existing save.
- Resolved over 6 null pointer errors, significantly increasing stability across the board.
- Fixed the 'scope blackout' issue during aiming for clearer targeting.
- Fixed a bug where mouse sensitivity could unexpectedly drop to zero.
- Fixed a crash that could happen when remapping multiple keybinds, get those controls just how you want them!
- Disabled gravity on zombies at death to prevent them from falling through the map. However, steep slopes might still be tricky.
- Synced client zombie positions post-death with the server to improve looting consistency.
- Heavily optimized and refactored zombie spawning method. Should be seeing more of them on the dedi now too but more to come on this soon!

[u][b]Dedi Server Upgrades:[/b][/u]
- Ensured autosave is always on in the MainLevel, so your progress is safely stored.
- Added password protection for dedicated servers for extra security.
- Resolved port issues for a more stable connection.
- Client version checks are in place to prevent mismatched server joins.

[u][b]Visual & Gameplay Tweaks:[/b][/u]
- Ramped up the details on some mountain meshes, making the landscape more vivid. (Not on the map yet!)
- Added a path to climb & parkour up the mountain with the radio tower (you may find some loot there).
- Cigs now reduce radiation by -25! A surprising twist in our post-apocalyptic world.
- More map enhancements and collision fixes to improve navigation and interaction. Keep the reports coming!

[u][b]Developer Notes:[/b][/u]
- We’re rigorously testing package builds and tweaking them as needed. More updates on this soon!

[u][b]Final Thoughts:[/b][/u]
Your feedback is invaluable in this journey, so keep it coming! Stay tuned for more exciting developments as we inch closer to the ultimate ZSGO adventure. 

Stay alert and survive, everyone!

notes.title: Early Access Beta: v0.4.3 Thanksgiving Update
notes.content:
[b]PATCH NOTES 0.4.3[/b]

[b]Happy Thanksgiving you guys![/b] 🦃 🦃 🦃 🦃 🦃 🦃 🦃 🦃 🦃 
We are excited to bring you some updates to kick off the holidays.
There are a few issues that we will need to work out. That's the name of the game though.
Bare with us survivors! And remember, your ⁠🦟│bug-reports are extremely helpful.

[u][b]Zombies and AI Mechanics 🧟‍♂️🤖:[/b][/u]
-Added 30-second cooldown for zombie spawn points ⏲️.
-Improved zombie removal from spawn manager post-player kills 💥. (Part of cause for no zombies on servers)
-Effect for zombies spawning added ✨.
-Enhanced AI spawning to prevent mid-air falls 🚫🌌.
-Temporary fix to reduce zombies falling through the map 🕳️.

[u][b]User Interface and Experience 🖥️👀:[/b][/u]
-Updated pause menu with new main level map 🗺️.
-Loading indicator shows during save progress, with a notification upon completion and save status 💾.
-Modified server browser menu to combine dedicated and listen server listings 🔍.
-Added road names to map and level 🛣️.

[u][b]Gameplay and Mechanics 🎮🛠️:[/b][/u]
-Ladders will lead to far less deaths!
-Fixed sprint function bug when key binding is changed ⚡.
-Fixed a bug where the time change wasn't activating on clients, affecting automatic lights and foliage emissive changes between day and night 🌞🌙.
-Resolved issue with save list not updating immediately after creating a new save 🔄.
-Attempted to fix player stash widget initialization issue, pending further testing 🧪.
-Resolved saving issues with build parts on dedicated servers 🏗️.
-Adjusted first-person hand animations for running, walking, and breathing to better match footsteps 👣.
-Fixed bug where some guns had higher movement speeds than the default 🏃‍♂️💨.
-Removed 'sonic mode' feature 🚫🔊.
-Container loot NERFED TO THE GROUND!!! 📉💥
-Item weight rebalance (nerfed to the ground) ⚖️.
-More Stone nodes.
-Many collisions were fixed 🔧.
-Adjusted weight of some items ⚖️.
-General consumable, resource, weapon loot nerfs 🍽️🔫.
-Crafting tweaks and increases the rarity of keycards 🔑.
-Taint transformer pickup fixed 🛠️.

[u][b]Market and Resources 🏪📈:[/b][/u]
-Added stone to market 🪨➕.
-Mineable resources used to make C4 are no longer in the market 🚫💣.

[b]Pointers:[/b]
Zombies may be a little weird with spawning on servers. We are looking into it more but it may work good for some.
Dedicated servers also seem to be going offline when certain players disconnect. We will be sure to have them running as much as possible, however if there are too many clients causing this issue on disconnect then we will most likely leave them down until we have a solution.

Thank you to everyone who helped out with bug reports. 
Any posts in ⁠🦟│bug-reports is absolutely huge for us!!!

See you out there survivors!

A big shoutout to everyone who's been experimenting with our Early Access Beta on the MainLevel. Your playtesting and bug reporting are immensely helping us grow the game. We've packed these updates with cool new stuff and improvements to enhance your survival adventure! Here are some of the major recent changes to the full game:

Added an Ocean to MainLevel - Unreal Engine didn't like our first one.
[b]New Quests![/b] Embark on fresh adventures with intriguing stories.
[b]New NPCs![/b] Discover new traders and their unique items.

[i][b]Fun Additions & Tweaks:[/b][/i]

[b]Added a Map in the pause menu[/b] for improved navigation.
Try out the [b]new Anti-Rad Showers[/b] for safer exploration.
Enjoy [b]better loot with updated Loot Tables[/b].

[i][b]Making Things Better:[/b][/i]

[b]Refined inventory[/b] and gear management.
Tutorial doors now remain open after their initial unlock.
Fixed issues with missions incorrectly completing.

[i][b]Techy Stuff:[/b][/i]

[b]Implemented lighting improvements[/b] for enhanced visual fidelity.
Conducted extensive [b]testing and optimizatio[/b]n across the board.

[b]Combat & Gear Updates:[/b]

[b]Introduced 5 new scope types[/b] for refined aiming. Addressing ongoing client-side ADS issues.
Tweaked [b]radiation and health mechanics[/b] for a more balanced experience.

Adjusted Zed spawners to maintain frame rates and enhance performance.

[b]Bug Awareness:[/b]
We're currently focused on resolving two prevalent bugs on our dedicated game servers, including an issue where zombies stop spawning after extended playtime. We appreciate your reports and are working hard on fixes.

[b]Stay Tuned for More ZSGO Announcements![/b]
We'll be back soon with more details and updates.
